summary.zh: 修复快速框选图标时必现的崩溃（内存耗尽）；欢迎页「启动新项目」现在会弹出对话框设置项目名称与字码前缀
summary.en: Fixes a guaranteed crash (out of memory) when rapidly marquee-selecting icons; the welcome screen's New Project button now opens a dialog to set the project name and icon-code prefix

zh: 修复：快速拖曳、反复改变框选区域大小时应用必现崩溃（Aborted(OOM)）——数据库查询句柄泄漏已根治，并加入守门测试防止同类问题复发
改进：框选拖曳时批量面板的数据库查询量降至原来的约三分之一，大量选中图标时拖曳更流畅
改进：欢迎页「启动新项目」复用常规新建项目流程，弹出对话框可设置项目名称与图标字码前缀
en: Fixed: A guaranteed crash (Aborted(OOM)) when rapidly dragging and resizing the marquee selection — the underlying database statement leak is fixed for good, with a guard test preventing regressions
Improved: The batch panel now issues roughly one third as many database queries while marquee-dragging, keeping large selections smooth
Improved: The welcome screen's New Project button reuses the standard new-project flow, opening a dialog to set the project name and icon-code prefix

summary.zh: 统一全应用的字体、字号、字重与颜色——修复分组、侧栏详情、筛选栏等处标签大小不一，以及字码输入框中文提示文字变形等问题；内置 Inter 字体让各操作系统显示保持一致
summary.en: Unifies fonts, sizes, weights and colors across the app — fixes inconsistent label sizing in the group, detail and filter panels and distorted Chinese placeholders in code inputs; bundles the Inter font for consistent rendering on every OS

zh: 修复：编辑分组、侧栏详情、底部筛选栏等处的标签字号/字重/颜色不一致（例如「分组名称」明显比「描述」更大更黑）——全应用文本现由统一的排版规范渲染
修复：字码区间「起始/结束」输入框内的中文提示文字掉入等宽字体而变形
改进：内置 Inter 与 Cascadia Code 字体随包离线加载，不同操作系统上的字体显示保持一致
改进：统一次要文字的深浅层级与状态色（警示统一为语义色），整体观感更整齐
en: Fixed: Inconsistent label size/weight/color across the edit-group dialog, detail sidebar and bottom filter bar (e.g. the group name appearing noticeably larger than the description) — all text now renders through a unified typography system
Fixed: Chinese placeholder text in the code-range Start/End inputs falling back to a monospace font and looking distorted
Improved: Bundles the Inter and Cascadia Code fonts, loaded offline with the app, for consistent rendering across operating systems
Improved: Unified the shades of secondary text and status colors for a tidier, more consistent look

summary.zh: 修复安装包内 CLI 无法运行的问题；更新提示浮窗限高可滚动、点击可放大查看，跨版本更新时聚合展示沿途所有版本的更新内容
summary.en: Fixes the bundled CLI failing to run in packaged builds; the update popup is now height-capped and scrollable with click-to-zoom, and aggregates release notes across all skipped versions

zh: 修复：安装包内 CLI 无法运行——点击「安装 CLI 到 PATH」或在终端执行 bobcorn 报 Cannot find module；CLI 产物现已自包含全部依赖，不再依赖应用包内的 node_modules
修复：未安装系统 Node.js 时，CLI 回退使用应用自带运行时（ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE），不再误启动第二个应用实例
改进：更新提示浮窗最高不超过窗口 1/3 高度，超长更新说明在浮窗内滚动，不再飞出屏幕
新增：点击更新提示浮窗可在居中弹窗中放大查看完整更新内容
新增：跨版本更新时聚合展示从当前版本到目标版本之间所有版本的更新说明，并以「v旧 → v新」标注版本区间
en: Fixed: The bundled CLI failing to run — "Install CLI to PATH" or running bobcorn in a terminal threw Cannot find module; the CLI artifact is now fully self-contained and no longer depends on node_modules inside the app package
Fixed: Without a system Node.js installed, the CLI now falls back to the app's own runtime (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE) instead of accidentally launching a second app instance
Improved: The update popup is capped at one third of the window height; long release notes scroll inside it instead of flying off-screen
New: Click the update popup to zoom into a centered dialog showing the full release notes
New: Cross-version updates aggregate the release notes of every version between the installed and the target version, labeled with a "vOld → vNew" range

summary.zh: 新增分组字码区间、图标框选与右键菜单、真实生效的排序与筛选、项目名称与字码前缀拆分；修复更新说明缺失、设置弹窗卡顿与分发包缺失 CLI 等问题
summary.en: New per-group code ranges, marquee selection and right-click context menu, working sort & filter, project name / code prefix split; fixes missing release notes, settings dialog freeze and missing CLI in packaged builds

zh: 新增：分组字码区间——为分组声明专属 PUA 区间（如 E100–E1FF），加入该组的图标自动在区间内按顺延/填洞分配字码；全局分配自动避开各组预留区；区间之间禁止重叠
新增：区间可视化选择矩阵（与项目设置的字码覆盖共用同一组件），支持 64/32/16/8 码/格缩放、拖拽框选并吸附十六进制边界、起止码直接输入；编辑区间导致本组图标越界时琥珀警示并需确认
新增：移动图标到有区间的分组时可选择「重新分配到区间内」或「保持原字码」；网格与编辑器对非本组字码显示琥珀标识，编辑器提供一键重新分配；筛选器新增「非本组字码」
新增：CLI 同步支持——group set-code-range / group check / icon move --reassign|--keep-codes / icon import --code-mode / project create --display-name
新增：图标网格框选（离屏图标可选中、边缘自动滚动、Ctrl 并集、Escape 取消）与图标右键菜单（收藏/移动/复制/导出/回收；回收站内恢复/彻底删除）
新增：排序真正生效（导入时间/更新时间/字码/名称 × 升降序），显示、排序与筛选合并为左下角单一面板，浮层带上滑过渡动画
新增：项目名称与图标字码前缀拆分为独立字段，新建项目对话框可分别填写，项目设置页均可编辑；字体产物命名继续跟随前缀
新增：移动/复制到分组统一为同一弹窗（含「未分组」选项与分组封面图标），单个、批量与右键三种入口交互一致
新增：导入成功提示区分「追加至字码末尾/填充空闲字码」；回收站顶部提示其中图标仍占用字码
改进：批量收藏状态实时同步并以半星区分混合状态；批量按钮展开/收缩过渡动画；取色器弹窗定位修复；提示图标由字符改为矢量图标；三栏空态字号统一；「未保存的更改」弹窗提供「保存并…/直接…」双操作
修复：更新卡片显示「无更新说明」——发布说明现直接来自 changelog 并新增发布门禁校验，弹窗不再被窗口左缘截断
修复：打开设置弹窗时 CLI 状态检测阻塞界面 3-5 秒（改为异步检测 + 会话缓存）；分发包缺失 CLI 组件导致安装失败（CLI 构建已挂入出包链）
修复：CLI 与图形界面字码分配语义分叉（命令行长期缺少「顺延末尾」模式）——分配逻辑统一为单一内核模块并由守门测试锁定
en: New: Per-group code ranges — reserve a dedicated PUA range (e.g. E100–E1FF) for a group; icons added to it are allocated within the range using append/fill; global allocation skips reserved ranges; ranges cannot overlap

New: Visual range picker matrix (shared with Project Settings code coverage), with 64/32/16/8 codes-per-cell zoom, drag selection snapping to hex boundaries and direct start/end input; editing a range warns and confirms when existing group icons would fall outside

New: Moving icons into a ranged group offers "reassign into range" or "keep codes"; out-of-range icons get an amber badge in grid and editor, with one-click reassign in the editor; new "out-of-range codes" filter
New: CLI parity — group set-code-range / group check / icon move --reassign|--keep-codes / icon import --code-mode / project create --display-name

New: Marquee (box) selection in the icon grid (off-screen icons selectable, edge auto-scroll, Ctrl union, Escape cancel) and right-click context menu (favorite/move/copy/export/recycle; restore/delete permanently in trash)
New: Sorting now actually works (import time / update time / code / name × asc/desc); display, sort and filter merged into a single bottom-left panel with slide-up transition
New: Project name and icon code prefix are now separate fields — set independently in the new-project dialog and editable in project settings; font artifacts keep following the prefix
New: Move/copy-to-group unified into one dialog (with an Ungrouped option and group cover icons), consistent across single, batch and context-menu entry points
New: Import toast distinguishes "appended to end" vs "filled gaps"; trash view notes that its icons still occupy code points

Improved: Batch favorite state syncs in real time with a half-star mixed indicator; batch button expand/collapse animation; color picker positioning fixed; character glyphs in toasts replaced with vector icons; empty-state typography unified; the unsaved-changes dialog now offers "Save & …" / "… anyway"
Fixed: Update card showing "no release notes" — release notes now come straight from the changelog with a publish gate, and the popup is no longer clipped by the window edge
Fixed: Settings dialog freezing 3-5s on open due to blocking CLI detection (now async with session cache); packaged builds missing the CLI component (CLI build wired into the packaging chain)
Fixed: Code allocation semantics diverging between CLI and GUI (append mode was missing in the CLI path) — allocation logic unified into a single kernel module locked by guard tests

summary.zh: 新增字码覆盖可视化与全链路字码健康：重复、非法、耗尽字码在导入、导出、编辑的每个触点可见并可一键修复；新增字码分配模式设置
summary.en: New code coverage visualization and end-to-end code health: duplicate, invalid and exhausted code points are now visible and fixable at every import/export/edit touchpoint, plus a new code allocation mode setting

zh: 新增：项目设置 → 项目信息新增「字码覆盖」方块矩阵，可视化 PUA 区 6400 个码位的占用、孔洞与尾部剩余空间，hover 查看区间详情
新增：检测到重复/越界字码时可一键修复，修复前逐项预览每个图标的 原码 → 新码 变更
新增：导出前字码审计——发现重复/非法字码时警告并可查看受影响图标清单（保留/丢弃/跳过），非法字码图标自动跳过，防止导出中途失败
新增：打开 .cp/.icp 项目后自动审计字码，发现问题时提示前往字码覆盖处理
新增：网格卡片与编辑器对重复字码显示琥珀色标识与警示条
新增：设置 → 字码分配，可选「顺延末尾」（默认，不复用已删图标的码位，保护已发布样式的引用稳定）或「填充孔洞」（最大化码位利用率）
新增：CLI `code fix` 命令（支持 --dry-run / --json），批量修复重复与非法字码
修复：字码耗尽时不再静默复用 E000 制造重复码，导入/复制/批量复制/变体生成均明确报错并汇报部分成功数量
修复：回收站中的图标不再被导出进字体与 CSS
修复：字码范围 off-by-one，最后一个码位 F8FF 现在可以被分配
en: New: Project Settings → Project Info gains a Code Coverage block matrix visualizing occupancy, holes and tail space of all 6400 PUA code points, with per-range hover details
New: One-click fix for duplicate/out-of-range codes, with a per-icon old → new preview before applying

New: Pre-export code audit — duplicates and invalid codes trigger a warning with an affected-icons list (kept/dropped/skipped); icons with invalid codes are skipped automatically so export no longer fails mid-pipeline
New: Opening a .cp/.icp project audits codes automatically and points to Code Coverage when issues are found
New: Grid cards and the editor highlight duplicate codes with amber markers and a warning banner
New: Settings → Code Allocation lets you choose Append (default — never reuses codes from deleted icons, keeping published stylesheets stable) or Fill gaps (maximizes code point utilization)
New: CLI `code fix` command (with --dry-run / --json) batch-repairs duplicate and invalid codes
Fixed: Code point exhaustion no longer silently reuses E000 and creates duplicates — import/copy/batch copy/variant generation now report errors with partial-success counts
Fixed: Icons in the recycle bin are no longer exported into fonts and CSS
Fixed: Off-by-one in the code range — the final code point F8FF can now be allocated

summary.zh: 导出图标字体的所有选项现在跟随用户态持久化，并支持在导出位置 input 内直接修改目录名
summary.en: Export icon font settings now persist per user, and the target directory name is editable directly in the export location input

zh: 新增：导出弹窗的所有选项（分组、可选格式、伴随文件、ZIP、导出位置、目录名）跟随用户态持久化，跨会话和项目保留
新增：导出位置 input 显示完整目标路径，可直接编辑末级目录名；勾选 ZIP 时自动补 .zip 后缀
新增：导出前校验目录名合法性与父目录可达性，错误立即提示而不进入管线
新增：目标已存在时弹出处理选项（覆盖 / 存储为自动后缀名 / 取消），目录与 .zip 文件冲突共用
改进：分组选择区改为小标题加滚动列表，去掉折叠头；数量摘要内置于全选行右侧
改进：[选择] 按钮高度与左侧 input 对齐
en: New: All export dialog options (groups, optional formats, companion files, ZIP, location, custom dir name) persist to user-level storage across sessions and projects
New: Export location input now shows the full target path and the trailing directory is editable in-place; the .zip suffix is auto-appended when ZIP mode is on
New: Pre-export validation rejects empty/illegal directory names and inaccessible parent directories with immediate error messages instead of failing mid-pipeline
New: When the target already exists, a 3-option dialog (Overwrite / Save as auto-suffixed name / Cancel) handles both directory and .zip file conflicts
Improved: The groups section is now a flat sub-title plus scrollable list (no collapsible header); count summary moved into the "Select all" row, right-aligned
Improved: The [Browse] button height now matches the input on its left

summary.zh: 修复编辑器中重命名图标或修改字码后，左侧网格未同步更新的问题
summary.en: Fix left grid not syncing after renaming icon or changing icon code in editor

zh: 修复：在右侧详情面板修改图标名称或字码后，左侧图标网格仍显示旧值
en: Fix: editing icon name or code in the right detail panel left the left grid showing stale values

summary.zh: 集成 Google Analytics 数据采集，新增隐私政策页面和用户同意机制
summary.en: Integrate Google Analytics with privacy-first consent system and policy page

zh: 新增 Analytics Gateway 架构：TypeScript 事件注册表 + 分层同意 + GA4 双写本地存储
新增首次使用 consent 卡片（左下角浮动，导出时触发，1-10 分钟随机延迟）
设置新增「数据共享」区域，支持基础/详细两级开关
全站 GA4 覆盖：主页、Wiki、隐私政策页、更新日志页
新增双语隐私政策页面 (bobcorn.caldis.me/privacy.html)
网站新增 Cookie 同意横幅和下载按钮点击统计
50+ 用户交互埋点：设置、文件菜单、项目设置、批量操作、工具栏、导出等
en: New Analytics Gateway: TypeScript event catalog + tiered consent + GA4 with local JSON store
First-use consent card (bottom-left floating, export-triggered, 1-10min random delay)
Settings: new Data Sharing section with basic/detailed toggle switches
GA4 coverage across all pages: homepage, Wiki, privacy policy, changelog
New bilingual privacy policy page (bobcorn.caldis.me/privacy.html)
Website cookie consent banner and download button click tracking
50+ UI interaction tracking points: settings, file menu, project settings, batch ops, toolbar, exports

summary.zh: 更新卡片显示多语言更新摘要，官网新增完整更新日志页
summary.en: Update card shows multilingual release summary, full changelog page on website

官网新增独立更新日志页，展示全部版本历史
首页展示最近 4 个版本更新，链接到完整日志
发版脚本自动校验 changelog 条目，防止遗漏
en: In-app update card fetches multilingual summary from changelog.json, replacing GitHub API
New standalone changelog page on website with full version history
Homepage shows latest 4 releases, links to full changelog
Release script validates changelog entry to prevent omissions

summary.zh: 颜色选择器支持主题跟随，下载直链优化
summary.en: Theme-aware color picker, direct download links

zh: 颜色选择器支持 currentColor 主题跟随，自动显示实际渲染色
下载按钮直链到对应平台安装包
导出行布局优化，格式选择移至最左
en: Color picker resolves currentColor to actual theme foreground
Download button links directly to platform installer
Export row layout improved, format selector moved to leading position

summary.en: Project settings, variant panel, state indicators

变体面板标记为 Beta 并默认折叠

Variant panel marked as Beta, collapsed by default
New project settings dialog (description, color)

CLI 命令自动发现项目文件

Fixed sql.js OOM on repeated project switching
CLI Wiki reference page in 16 languages
CLI auto-discovers project files for all commands

en: Icon export: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, ICO multi-format support
Custom size, scale, and background color options

en: Sidebar toggle with drop zone overlay and resize UX
Window controls, dialog scroll, group icons, and sticky headers overhaul

en: Batch prefetch SVG content for visible icons in grid
Placeholder height with staggered fade-in animation
Icon font Wiki knowledge base in 16 languages
Redesigned SideEditor section headers with icons

summary.en: Batch operations and virtual rendering
